item.title: Radiology, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence And Human Understanding
item.description:
# Radiology, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence And Human Understanding ## Summary Radiologists also study AI reliability through journals and actively research "Explainable Artificial Intelligence," which generates heat maps and descriptions to help human physicians.
To this end, there is active research in the field of “ [Explainable Artificial Intelligence](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12809972/)“ (XAI), in which an AI system explains its “reasoning” to human physicians.

item.title: Sam Altman Absolutely Hates the Idea of People Running Their Own AI Models at Home, Argues They Shouldn't Own Computers
item.description:
Instead of running their own models at home, a trend that has blown up thanks to the [emergence of open-weight models from China](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/openai-china-models-profit-money), Altman argued that the cloud — run by hyperscalers like OpenAI — is the answer.
Just earlier this month, Altman [argued](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/sam-altman-world-suffer-glories-ai) that the “world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of this technology,” which similarly drew a heated response.
